title: Heavenly Vessel | The Line Originals | THE LINE Studio
description: Directoral debut by Venla Linna, Heavenly Vessel is the story of a space-dwelling Monarchy, shaken by the arrival of a hypnotic, luminous dwarf planet.

attrs.class: p6 module-team fw470 slash-light gutters case-hero-team__copy

children: The uneasy stasis of a space-dwelling Monarchy is shaken by the arrival of a hypnotic, luminous dwarf planet. Caught between the authoritarian Duke and the impulsive Prince, all will come to light.

Heavenly Vessel explores the fear of transformation and change. What's particularly exciting about this project is that it marks the directorial debut of Venla, who was the second person we hired when we started our studio. Seeing her growth as an artist and leader has been amazing, and we're proud to see her at the helm of this film. It's also the first short to come out of our development department

attrs.class: p3 module-team fw470 slash-light gutters module-proxy

children: I was at first too embarrassed for Heavenly Vessel to mean anything, because that level of sincerity felt awkward and too exposing, and it was an uphill battle to get me to say what the film was about. Maybe specifically because of that fact, it became about the three decade long war that I have with myself, where every wall I build around myself will inevitably have to come down in the name of progress. It feels something like a second, third, or fourth puberty; tender and gruesome.
I find it easy to love this film, not because it's mine, but because it's not
mine - it's an amalgamation of the ideas and feelings of all the people who contributed to it, and embraced my naive story so wholeheartedly.
